components.purpose: Compact water-based hazer, 278 × 150 × 223 mm (L × W × H) and 3.3 kg, with a silent-running fan.

components.label: 1.5 L fluid tank
components.purpose: 0.4 gal / 1.5 L tank for HFG, HF5 EU or HFDJ5 EU fluid at 4 ml/min, so a full tank runs for hours at full output.

components.label: Output nozzle and fan
components.purpose: Front output, 800 cfm, after a 2-minute heat-up.

components.purpose: Built-in display for DMX address and standalone haze settings; the volume knob runs it without DMX.

components.label: Power inlet
components.purpose: IEC inlet, 120 VAC 60 Hz, 303 W / 2.5 A on the Chauvet sheet. Retailers list 188 W; the sheet wins until measured.

Simulated hazer state



Connections and controls
Each button only reads back what the manufacturer document says that connector or control does.


Haze on a budget circuit
At 2.5 A the hazer is the heaviest draw among the small effects. Give it two minutes before the doors and keep the DMX chain terminated if the volume knob is not in use.
Address and output are not simulated.
